sources.title: Public land map
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's public land map supports identification and release of publicly owned land and reports GLA Group portfolio pipelines. Map or portfolio presence is not treated as ownership proof for a sample parcel without an exact spatial/title match.

sources.title: Land and development
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's land and development programme covers GLA land assets, Small Sites, GLAP and development governance. Programme availability is strategic context rather than a parcel delivery commitment.

sources.title: GLA Land and Property Limited
sources.verified_claim: GLAP manages and develops Mayor-owned land and joint-venture interests and states a long-run ambition of up to 68,000 homes. Portfolio ambition does not establish that any sample parcel is GLAP-owned or deliverable.

sources.title: Small Sites for Small Builders site release fund
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 fund supports investigations, due diligence and feasibility for small public or registered-provider sites and had a 10 July 2026 application deadline. Funding eligibility and programme support do not prove site suitability or parcel ownership.

sources.title: Is GLAP delivering for London?
sources.verified_claim: The London Assembly reports GLAP's portfolio ambition and delivery progress while highlighting slower delivery than the long-term forecast. This counter-signal is retained and prevents pipeline targets being treated as completed housing.

sources.title: Current schemes
sources.verified_claim: Enfield lists current council-led schemes with site-specific status, including planning and construction milestones for named estates. These are exact scheme pages for those named sites only and are not generalized to parcel_30762.

sources.title: 12 Sites Regeneration Programme
sources.verified_claim: Havering's 12 Sites programme gives phase-by-phase estimated homes, planning, construction and completion dates and marks some sites under review. Programme timelines are site-specific to listed schemes and do not establish delivery at parcel_46142.

sources.title: Call for Sites
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's 2026 Call for Sites invited land suggestions for future housing, commercial uses and infrastructure and states submissions will be assessed for possible plan inclusion. Submission or consideration is not a site allocation or permission.
